title: IIAs Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) prep test

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of internal auditing?
answers: To provide independent assurance that an organization’s risk management, governance, and internal control processes are operating effectively.
To enforce organizational policies and procedures.
To prepare financial statements for external auditors.
feedbacks: This is correct; this defines the core purpose of internal auditing.
This is incorrect; internal auditing evaluates, not enforces policies.
This is incorrect; this is the responsibility of accounting, not internal auditing.
This is incorrect; strategy development is typically a management function.
questions.explanation: Internal auditing evaluates the effectiveness of risk management, control, and governance processes.

questions.question: Which of the following is a component of the COSO Internal Control Framework?
feedbacks: This is correct; the control environment is one of the five components.
This is incorrect; this is not one of the five COSO components.

This is incorrect; this is not a COSO component.
questions.explanation: The COSO Framework includes Control Environment, Risk Assessment, Control Activities, Information & Communication, and Monitoring.

questions.question: Which of the following best defines inherent risk?

This is incorrect; this is a type of regulatory risk.
questions.explanation: Inherent risk refers to the level of risk present in an activity before considering mitigating controls.

questions.question: What is a key objective of the internal audit charter?

To monitor compliance with all organizational policies.
